slot.brief: Two statements with overlapping middle term; give four conclusions including one either-or pair and a possibility conclusion; ask which conclusions definitely follow.

stem:
**Statements:**

All pens are tools.

Some tools are books.

All books are papers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some pens are books.

II. Some papers are tools.

III. All books are tools.

IV. No pen is book.

Which of the conclusions follow?
options: Only II follows and either I or IV follows

verdicts.working: II follows: some tools are books, and all books are papers, so some papers are tools. I and IV are contradictory alternatives, so one of them must hold, but neither follows individually. III does not follow.
issues: The option images show chemical structures unrelated to the reasoning question and do not match the text options.

working:
Some tools are books and all books are papers, so some tools are papers, i.e. some papers are tools: II follows. I and IV are contradictory (some pens are books vs no pen is book); neither is forced, so either I or IV follows. III is not forced. Hence only II plus either I or IV follows.

Independent check: II follows: some tools are books, and all books are papers, so some papers are tools. I and IV are contradictory alternatives, so one of them must hold, but neither follows individually. III does not follow.
solution:
Some tools are books, and all books are papers; hence some papers are tools, so II follows.
I and IV are contradictory alternatives: neither follows individually, but either I or IV must hold.
III does not follow; therefore, only II follows and either I or IV follows.
